facts.fact: The MeteoSwiss peer review says METTELSAT has a functional PUMA satellite reception system at its headquarters giving access to EUMETCast.
The review says METTELSAT forecasters assemble the daily next-day forecast for the major cities manually, primarily from ARPEGE and GFS model material and METEOSAT images.

note: No satellite-based warnings: the review says METTELSAT has no warning and alert service; no ISO 9001 certification stated.
